stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple for allegedly blocking its hardware suppliers
stories.blurb: OpenAI claims Apple is threatening suppliers who work with the ChatGPT maker and encouraged employees to store corporate files on personal devices. The countersuit escalates a legal fight Apple started in July, when it accused OpenAI of stealing iPhone and Apple Watch design secrets through former Apple employees now working on OpenAI's consumer hardware plans.
stories.why_it_matters: Two of tech's biggest players are now accusing each other of industrial espionage over AI hardware.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI countersues Apple, alleging trade secret theft and supplier threats

stories.headline: Nvidia's CEO apologizes to employees, says he's in therapy
stories.blurb: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia and told employees he violated the company's code of conduct and 'made some terrible mistakes.' He acknowledged entering therapy. The specific violations weren't detailed in public statements.
stories.why_it_matters: The face of the AI chip industry just admitted serious misconduct at the company powering most AI development.
stories.original_headline: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees, Says He Is in Therapy

stories.headline: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT and Work — heavy users will hit limits faster
stories.blurb: OpenAI started rolling out a unified ChatGPT experience that shares one usage meter across chat and work tasks. The company admits its heaviest users will hit rate limits sooner than before, even while paying the same subscription price. The basic 'Instant' model stays unlimited.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a power user, you'll get less access to advanced models for the same money.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work

stories.headline: Nvidia stops shipping AI chips to Southeast Asia
stories.blurb: Nvidia told Dell and Super Micro to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia while it checks whether partners meet U.S. export rules. Chinese companies have been accessing Nvidia chips remotely through data centers in those countries — a loophole the Commerce Department closed earlier this month.
stories.why_it_matters: About a quarter of China's AI computing power comes from these remote data centers.
stories.original_headline: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia

stories.headline: 42 state AGs move to block Character.AI from selling user chats in bankruptcy
stories.blurb: A bipartisan coalition says Character.AI plans to auction off chat histories from 21 million US accounts—including 2.1 million minors—with no privacy protections or deletion options. The first bidder was incorporated just days before the auction, with no listed parent company or investors.
stories.why_it_matters: Your AI chat logs could become an asset sold to the highest bidder when companies go bankrupt.
stories.original_headline: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
